name: Ingredient/allergen/nutrition model
authority: Owner-directed contract newly formalizes the previously provisional FOOD-003C candidate. Compatible with FOOD-003 vision, FOOD-001A disclosure/review rules and FOOD-003A/B exact formulation boundaries.

contract.ingredientReference: No standalone ingredient ID exists. Use exact recipe/component id, positive-safe version and zero-based ingredientIndex, validated against supplied draft/component. Ingredient value is detached from that exact context. Component indices refer to composition lines; recipe indices refer to draft ingredients.
contract.profile: Explicit basisGrams=100; four required nutrients energyKcal, proteinGrams, carbohydrateGrams, fatGrams. Each is known finite nonnegative value or explicit unknown. Known zero is valid; missing/null is invalid. Completeness derived from all four states.
contract.source: Bounded immutable opaque sourceReference/version; no latest resolution, network fetch, trust or existence claim. Source revision identifies the ingredient nutrition profile inputs without inventing persistence IDs.
contract.allergens: Reuse FoodAllergenReview states and canonical declaration validation via additive export. Reviewed ingredient facts require separate exact source/version, reviewDate and reviewer evidence. This local evidence is scoped by the enclosing ingredient reference; existing FoodEvidence is recipe/product-scoped and cannot correctly represent component-ingredient review. Existing FoodEvidence is unchanged and no review evidence is synthesized for canonical recipes.
contract.disclosure: Undisclosed purchased ingredients remain unresolved even with reviewed declarations. Unknown/pending states retain explicit declarations; absence is never proof of absence. Aggregation retains input reviews and evidence, first-seen declaration order and distinct details. Deduplicate identical allergen/detail facts, never erase conflicting species details. Aggregate is a projection, not a new canonical review or allergen-free claim.
contract.component: Validate exact FOOD-003B component and require one matching profile per direct input. Reject missing, wrong or duplicate profiles. Contribution=inputGrams/100*source value; total sums in formulation order. Any unknown contribution makes that nutrient unknown. Per100=total/yieldGrams*100. No retention/loss assumptions beyond this owner-specified formula.
contract.recipe: Validate FOOD-003B formulation against exact draft/component contexts. Direct inputs use exact profiles. Component inputs consume structurally validated already-derived component profiles matching exact id/version and exact supplied component formulation. No recursion or latest substitution. Component profile provenance retains ingredient references, source revisions and allergen evidence. Caller-supplied derived values are data, not independently authenticated computation evidence.
contract.numericPolicy: Finite nonnegative JavaScript numbers, no rounding or energy-from-macros calculation. Reject overflow in contributions, totals or yield normalization; do not silently expose Infinity or NaN.
contract.provenance: Derived result retains exact detached formulation, ordered input nutrient snapshots and exact ingredient/source or component-profile provenance. No full external source payload. This preserves source revisions even when later profiles use the same formulation version.
contract.immutability: All boundary values copied and recursively frozen. Source/profile arrays bounded to 128; source references/reviewers to 512 characters. No environment lookup, IO or automatic capture conversion.
contract.separation: Ingredient, nutrition profile, recipe/version, component/version, product, SKU/package, cost, prototype capture and customer instructions remain distinct. Nutrition completeness does not confer trust, legal compliance, publication or sale authority.

operations: Synthetic fixtures only; no real recipes/datasets, remote actions, Cloudflare/D1/KV mutation, deployment, staging, commit or push.
